judgment.interpretation: The semantic meaning of NODI code 9 for FY2025 no-numeric-result DMR rows is not established from admissible workspace evidence. Structural observation (empty DMR_VALUE_NMBR with NODI_CODE=9 on NM0020583, co-occurrence with WET retest and chlorine parameters) does not constitute a definition. NODI code 9 must not inherit NODI code C semantics per the relation contract, but that exclusion does not identify what code 9 positively denotes.
